products.name: Omelette Rice
products.description: Omelette Rice is a Japanese dish that consists of fried rice enveloped in a thin omelette. The fried rice is commonly flavored with ingredients like vegetables, chicken, or beef and seasoned with ketchup. The omelette is partially cooked and then folded over the rice, creating a delicious and visually appealing dish.

products.name: Seafood Fried Rice
products.description: Seafood Fried Rice: A savory blend of fluffy rice, shrimp, crab, or fish, and vibrant vegetables. Stir-fried to perfection with soy sauce and spices, it's a delicious medley of seafood flavors and textures.

products.name: Dak Gang Jeon
products.description: Dak Gang Jeon is Korean Fried Chicken crispy, seasoned chicken fried to perfection and coated in a savory-sweet glaze. A delightful combination of crunch and flavor.

products.name: Yang Nyeom Chicken
products.description: 10 pcs - Yang Nyeom Chicken: Korean fried chicken tossed in a spicy, flavorful sauce featuring gochujang, garlic, ginger, and soy sauce. Enjoy the perfect balance of crispy and spicy goodness.

products.name: Korean Fried Chicken
products.description: 10 pcs  - Korean-style Fried Chicken is a crispy delightgolden-fried chicken coated in a savory sauce infused with soy, garlic, and ginger. It's a perfect harmony of crunch and bold flavor.

products.name: Oh Jingeo Tuigim
products.description: Squid tempura

products.name: Haemul Pajeon - Seafood Pancake
products.description: Haemul Pajeon: Korean Seafood Pancake savory pancake with shrimp, squid, and green onions, pan-fried to golden perfection. Served with a soy-based dipping sauce for a delightful blend of flavors.

products.name: Chicken Kkanpunggi
products.description: Chicken Kkanpunggi: A Korean-Chinese delight deep-fried chicken stir-fried in a spicy garlic sauce with bell peppers and onions. A perfect blend of crispy, tender, sweet, and spicy flavors.

products.name: Mixed Tempura
products.description: Mixed Tempura: A Japanese delight with an assortment of seafood and vegetables dipped in a light, crispy batter and deep-fried. Served with a dipping sauce for a satisfying mix of textures and flavors.

products.name: Haemul Kimchi Jeon - Seafood Kimchi Pancake
products.description: Haemul Kimchi Jeon: Korean Seafood Kimchi Pancake-flavorful batter with kimchi and assorted seafood, pan-fried to golden perfection. Served with a soy-based dipping sauce for a delightful blend of tastes and textures.

products.name: Kimchi Jeon - Kimchi Pan Cake
products.description: Kimchi Jeon, or Kimchi Pancake, is a beloved Korean dish made by pan-frying a batter of flour, water, and eggs mixed with kimchi. The result is a savory and crispy pancake with the distinct tangy and spicy flavor of kimchi. Kimchi Jeon is often enjoyed as a tasty and satisfying snack or appetizer, typically served with a dipping sauce.

products.name: Tofu Jeon - Tofu Pan Cake
products.description: Tofu Jeon: Korean Tofu Pancake - soft inside, crispy outside. Crafted with tofu, flour, water, and eggs, seasoned with green onions. Served with a dipping sauce for a tasty and versatile delight.

products.name: Gyeran Mari  - Egg Roll
products.description: Gyeran Mari: Korean rolled omelette, a simple and versatile dish made with whisked eggs and vegetables. Sliced into rounds, it's a popular side dish in Korean cuisine.

products.name: Fried Crab
products.description: Fried Crab : Crab seasoned and deep-fried to perfection, offering a delightful combination of crispy texture and savory flavor - a delicious choice in Korean seafood cuisine.

products.name: Beef Teriyaki
products.description: Beef Teriyaki: Tender strips of beef glazed in a savory-sweet teriyaki sauce, offering a delicious harmony of flavors. A popular and satisfying dish in Japanese cuisine.

products.name: Tteok - Bokki with Chicken Mandu
products.description: Tteok-bokki with fried chicken mandu is a popular Korean dish. Tteok-bokki consists of chewy rice cakes in a spicy and sweet gochujang-based sauce. The addition of fried chicken mandu, or dumplings, complements the dish with savory and crispy textures. It's a delightful and flavorful street food often enjoyed for its spicy kick and satisfying combination of rice cakes and fried dumplings.

products.name: Chicken Teriyaki
products.description: Chicken Teriyaki: Succulent chicken glazed in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, creating a delightful blend of flavors. A popular and satisfying dish in Japanese cuisine.

products.name: Chicken Tangsu - Sweet & Sour Chicken
products.description: Chicken Tangsu: Korean-Chinese Sweet and Sour Chicken - crispy fried pieces glazed in a perfect blend of sweet and tangy sauce. A delightful fusion of flavors and textures.

products.name: Beef Tangsu - Sweet & Sour Beef
products.description: Beef Tangsu: Korean-Chinese sweet and sour beef - tender slices fried and coated in a flavorful balance of sweetness and tanginess. A delicious blend of textures and tastes.

products.name: Garlic Mushroom
products.description: Garlic Mushrooms: Plump mushrooms sautéed in a rich blend of garlic-infused butter, creating a simple yet deeply flavorful dish perfect as a side or appetizer. The aromatic combination of garlic and butter enhances the earthy essence of the mushrooms, making it a delightful addition to any meal.

products.name: Prawn Tangsu
products.description: Prawn Tangsu: Succulent prawns coated in a sweet and tangy sauce, offering a delightful fusion of flavors. A Korean-Chinese dish with crispy texture and vibrant taste.

products.name: Spicy Seafood Bulgogi
products.description: Spicy Seafood Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, rice vinegar, and red pepper flakes. Seafood and optional vegetables are marinated - garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, and serve over rice or noodles. Adjust spice level to taste.

products.name: Spicy Beef Bulgogi
products.description: Spicy Beef Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Thinly sliced beef is marinated and then grilled or cooked in a skillet for a savory, sweet, and spicy flavor. Serve over rice or in lettuce wraps, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. Adjust spice level to taste.

products.name: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
products.description: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Chicken pieces are marinated, grilled or cooked until caramelized, and served over rice or in wraps. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

products.name: Spicy Squid & Octopus Bulgogi
products.description: Spicy Squid & Octopus Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Squid and octopus are marinated and grilled until tender. Serve over rice or noodles, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.

products.name: Squid Bulgogi
products.description: Squid Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring squid marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Grill or cook until tender, then serve over rice or noodles. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, adjusting the spice level to taste.

products.name: Octopus Bulgogi
products.description: Octopus Bulgogi is a Korean dish where octopus is marinated in a flavorful mixture of soy sauce, gochujang (Korean red pepper paste), sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Grill or cook until tender, then serve over rice or noodles. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, adjusting the spice level to taste.

products.name: Spicy Haemul Bokom
products.description: Spicy Haemul Bokkeum is a Korean seafood stir-fry with shrimp, squid, and mussels. It features a spicy sauce with gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger. Serve over rice or noodles, adjusting the spice level to taste.

products.name: Yulingi Crispy Chicken Salad
products.description: Lingi Crispy Chicken Salad features thinly sliced chicken deep-fried with a secret masala, served alongside fresh vegetables as a dressing.

products.name: Tuna Dadiki Salad
products.description: Tuna Tataki Salad is a Japanese dish featuring lightly seared tuna slices on fresh greens. The tuna is seared on the outside, leaving the inside raw. It's served with a flavorful dressing, such as soy-based or citrusy ponzu, and may include toppings like sesame seeds and green onions for added texture and taste.

products.name: Seafood Salad
products.description: Seafood salad is a harmonious blend of boiled shrimp, crab, squid, and octopus, along with glass noodles and crisp vegetables. What sets it apart is the bespoke tangy dressing, enhancing the freshness of the seafood.

products.name: Boiled Chicken Salad
products.description: Boiled chicken salad features tender chicken on a bed of fresh greens and vegetables, seasoned with herbs and spices. Customize with toppings and dressing for a light, nutritious meal.

products.name: Chicken Cashewnut Salad
products.description: Chicken Cashew Nut Salad combines tender chicken, crunchy cashews, and fresh vegetables. The salad is enriched with vibrant greens and a flavorful dressing, creating a balanced and satisfying meal.

products.name: Yuk Gae Jang
products.description: Yuk Gae Jang is a spicy Korean soup with shredded beef, vegetables, and glass noodles in a flavorful broth made with gochugaru. Seasoned with soy sauce, garlic, and sesame oil, it's a hearty and warming dish.

products.name: Doenjang-jjigae
products.description: Doenjang-jjigae is a Korean stew featuring fermented soybean paste, tofu, vegetables, and optionally meat or seafood. Seasoned with garlic and soy sauce, it offers a rich and savory flavor, often served with rice.

products.name: Spicy Mixed Seafood Soup
products.description: Spicy Mixed Seafood Soup is a flavorful dish that combines various seafood, such as shrimp, squid  in a spicy broth. The soup often includes an assortment of vegetables, like onions, mushrooms, and green onions. The spiciness comes from ingredients like chili flakes or chili paste.

products.name: Spicy Seafood Noodles Soup
products.description: Spicy Seafood Noodle Soup is a dish featuring a mix of seafood, like shrimp, squid in a spicy broth served with noodles. The soup is known for its bold and flavorful combination of spicy and savory elements, making it a popular choice for those who enjoy a kick of heat with their seafood.

products.name: Seafood Doenjang-jjigae
products.description: Seafood Doenjang-jjigae is a Korean stew blending fermented soybean paste with seafood like shrimp, clams, and squid. Enriched with vegetables, it creates a savory broth seasoned with garlic and soy sauce. Typically served with rice, it's a comforting and popular dish in Korean cuisine.

products.name: Kimchi Jjigae with Beef
products.description: Kimchi Jjigae with Beef is a Korean stew that combines kimchi, beef, tofu, and various vegetables. The main components are kimchi and beef, creating a rich and flavorful broth. The stew is often seasoned with gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes), garlic, and soy sauce. Kimchi Jjigae with Beef is known for its spicy and tangy taste, and it's a popular comfort food in Korean cuisine. It is usually served with a bowl of rice.

products.name: Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken
products.description: Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken is a variation of the classic Korean stew that usually features kimchi, chicken, tofu, and vegetables. The dish is known for its robust and flavorful broth created by the combination of fermented kimchi and chicken. Gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes) and other seasonings add spice and depth to the stew. It's a comforting and satisfying dish, often enjoyed with a side of rice.

products.name: Dak Gae Jang
products.description: Dak Gae Jang, also known as Spicy Korean Chicken Stew, is a flavorful dish where fresh chicken is simmered in a spicy broth. The broth is crafted with soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and Korean red pepper flakes (gochugaru), providing a bold and spicy flavor. Often featuring green onions and other vegetables, this hearty stew is enjoyed for its rich taste and is commonly served with rice for a satisfying meal.

products.name: Miso Soup
products.description: Miso Soup is a traditional Japanese soup with a savory broth made from fermented soybean paste (miso). It typically includes tofu, seaweed, and green onions, offering a simple and comforting dish.

products.name: Miyeok Soup
products.description: Miyeok Soup, or Korean Seaweed Soup, is a traditional dish featuring miyeok seaweed simmered in a flavorful broth with ingredients like beef or anchovy stock, garlic, and soy sauce. It is often enriched with tofu, vegetables, and sometimes protein, providing a nourishing and mild-flavored soup.

products.name: Japchae
products.description: Korean glass noodles with veggies & sesame oil

products.name: Jajangmyeon With Chicken
products.description: Jajangmyeon with chicken is a fusion dish combining the classic Korean-Chinese black bean noodles with tender chicken. The result is a hearty and satisfying meal with rich and savory flavors.

products.name: Tteok Mandu Guk
products.description: Tteok Mandu Guk is a traditional Korean soup with rice cake slices (tteok) and dumplings (mandu) in a clear broth, symbolizing good luck. Seasoned with garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil, it offers a comforting and flavorful experience

products.name: Beef Bulgogi Fried Noodles
products.description: Beef Bulgogi Fried Noodles is a delightful Korean dish where tender slices of marinated beef, known as bulgogi, are stir-fried with noodles. The bulgogi marinade typically includes soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and other seasonings, imparting a sweet and savory flavor to the beef. Mixed with noodles, this dish becomes a flavorful and satisfying fusion of Korean and stir-fry cuisine, offering a delicious combination of textures and tastes.

products.name: Mixed Fried Noodles
products.description: Mixed Fried Noodles that made with Korean spices is a flavorful dish that combines a medley of ingredients. It features stir-fried noodles with chicken, shrimp, assorted vegetables, and eggs. The Korean spices bring a unique and savory twist to the dish, creating a delicious fusion of textures and flavors in every bite.

products.name: Hot Spicy Ramen
products.description: Hot Spicy Ramen is a popular and fiery Japanese noodle dish known for its intense spiciness. It typically consists of Chinese-style wheat noodles served in a broth made with chili oil, sausages , soy sauce, miso, and other seasonings. This is not a soup noodles its gravy .

products.name: Shin Ramen
products.description: Shin Ramen is a renowned South Korean instant noodle brand celebrated for its bold and spicy flavor profile. After cooking, enthusiasts often customize their Shin Ramyun by adding eggs. Whether poached in the hot broth or separately prepared, the eggs contribute a delightful richness to the noodles, enhancing the overall taste and texture of this popular and convenient dish.

products.name: Mandu Ramen
products.description: Mandu Ramen is a Korean fusion dish pairing ramen noodles with savory dumplings (mandu) in a flavorful broth. Combining the comfort of noodles with the deliciousness of dumplings, it creates a hearty and satisfying bowl.

products.name: Soya Ramen
products.description: Soy Ramen is a savory noodle dish featuring a rich broth made with soy paste, complemented by a mix of fresh vegetables, eggs, and tender beef. The dish is completed with hearty noodles, creating a satisfying and flavorful bowl that combines the umami goodness of soy with the comforting elements of ramen.

products.name: California Roll
products.description: 8 pcs - California Roll: A timeless classic, our California Roll boasts a delectable blend of imitation or real crab, crisp cucumber, and creamy avocado, expertly rolled in seaweed and rice. Served with pickled ginger, wasabi, and soy sauce on the side, this roll delivers a delightful fusion of flavors and textures in every bite.

products.name: Beef Kimbap
products.description: 8 pcs - Beef Kimbap is a Korean roll with seasoned beef, vegetables, and pickled radish wrapped in seaweed and rice. Sliced for convenience, it delivers a savory and balanced flavor in every bite.

products.name: Tuna Kimbap
products.description: 8 pcs - Tuna Kimbap is a Korean dish that involves seasoned tuna, vegetables, and pickled radish rolled in seaweed and rice. Similar to other kimbap varieties, it is a convenient and flavorful way to enjoy a balanced mix of ingredients in a portable roll. Tuna Kimbap is often sliced into bite-sized pieces for easy consumption, offering a tasty and satisfying snack or meal.

products.name: Tuna Sushi Nigiri
products.description: 8 pcs - Tuna Sushi Nigiri is a classic Japanese sushi consisting of bite-sized, hand-pressed mounds of vinegared rice topped with fresh tuna. The tuna is typically sliced thinly and draped over the rice. It's often served with a small amount of wasabi between the rice and fish, offering a delightful combination of tender tuna and seasoned rice.

products.name: Shrimp Roll
products.description: 8 pcs - Shrimp Roll with Cheese is a delectable sushi roll filled with fried prawn, creamy avocado, and crisp cucumber. The addition of cheese adds a rich and savory twist to this flavorful combination of ingredients.

products.name: Shrimp Sushi
products.description: 8 pcs - Shrimp Sushi Nigiri is a classic Japanese sushi consisting of bite-sized mounds of vinegared rice topped with fresh shrimp. The shrimp is often served raw or lightly cooked, providing a delicate and slightly sweet flavor. Shrimp Sushi Nigiri is typically garnished with a small amount of wasabi between the rice and shrimp, offering a delightful and simple sushi experience.

products.name: Baechu Kimchi
products.description:
300 gm - 
Baechu Kimchi is a classic Korean dish of fermented Napa cabbage. The cabbage is seasoned with a paste containing gochugaru, garlic, ginger, and fish sauce, creating a spicy, tangy, and flavorful condiment that is a staple in Korean cuisine.

products.name: Beef Sui-Mai
products.description: 6 pcs -Beef Sui Mai is a  dim sum featuring seasoned ground beef encased in a thin dumpling wrapper. This savory variation is commonly enjoyed with dipping sauces like soy sauce or chili oil.

products.name: Beef Mandu
products.description: 6 pcs - Beef Mandu is a Korean dumpling filled with seasoned ground beef and vegetables, offering a savory taste. These dumplings are commonly boiled, steamed, or pan-fried and are often served with dipping sauces for added flavor.

products.name: Prawn Har-Gow
products.description: 6 pcs - Prawn Hargow is a Cantonese dim sum featuring translucent dumpling wrappers filled with minced or whole shrimp. Steamed to perfection, these dumplings showcase the vibrant pink color of the prawns, offering a delicate and juicy texture in each bite.

products.name: Beef Har-Gow
products.description: 6 pcs - Har Gow is a Cantonese dim sum featuring translucent dumpling wrappers filled with minced or whole shrimp, showcasing a delicate and juicy texture. It's a classic dish known for its shrimp filling, not typically made with beef.

products.name: Chicken Har-Gow
products.description: 6 pcs - Har Gow is a Cantonese dim sum with translucent wrappers filled with minced or whole shrimp. While traditionally made with shrimp, there isn't a common version with chicken filling. For chicken-filled dumplings, you might explore other dim sum options like Chicken Shumai.

products.name: Prawn Sui-Mai
products.description: 6 pcs - Prawn Sui Mai is a classic Cantonese dim sum featuring open-faced dumplings filled with a mixture of minced or whole prawns, sometimes combined with pork and various seasonings. These dumplings are typically topped with a small piece of roe or garnish and are steamed to perfection.

products.name: Chicken Sui-Mai
products.description: 6 pcs - Chicken Sui Mai is a Cantonese dim sum variation with minced chicken, seasonings, and sometimes shiitake mushrooms or water chestnuts. These open-faced dumplings are steamed, offering a delightful blend of flavors and textures.
